description:
Reid Original Gravel | Gravel bike
Durable, versatile and built for adventure – the ideal entry-level gravel bike for exploring off-road trails, commuting through town and enjoying weekend rides beyond the tarmac.
The Reid Bikes Original Gravel is designed to make gravel riding accessible, combining dependable construction with practical components and excellent value. Whether you're discovering gravel cycling for the first time, looking for a rugged everyday commuter or simply wanting a versatile bike for exploring new routes, it's built to handle a variety of riding conditions.
Its Hi-Ten steel frame and matching rigid steel fork provide a robust foundation for everyday use and off-road adventures. The durable construction makes it a practical choice for regular commuting and recreational riding, while 700C double-wall alloy rims and wide 40C tyres offer a useful balance of stability, grip and rolling efficiency across gravel paths, cycle routes and urban streets.
A 7-speed LTWOO drivetrain combines a 50/34T double chainset with a 14–28T freewheel, providing a practical range of gears for flat roads, everyday journeys and moderate inclines. Integrated LTWOO shifters combine gear changes and braking controls in one intuitive setup, helping keep your hands comfortably positioned on the handlebars while riding.
Cantilever brakes provide dependable stopping power for everyday cycling, while quick-release hubs make wheel removal more convenient for maintenance and transport. The 440mm-wide handlebars feature a 12-degree flare to offer a broader hand position and added control, particularly when riding on uneven surfaces. A 27.2mm alloy seatpost and supportive saddle complete the setup, helping keep you comfortable on everyday commutes and longer recreational rides.
Finished with a classic colour scheme and complementary decals, the Reid Bikes Original Gravel combines timeless styling with straightforward functionality. With its durable construction and versatile setup, it's an accessible way to start exploring gravel routes, enjoy weekend adventures and make everyday cycling more rewarding.
The Reid Bikes Original Gravel bike is ideal for:

First-time gravel riders, looking for an affordable introduction to riding beyond paved roads

Everyday commuters, with a durable steel frame and versatile tyres for urban journeys and cycle paths

Gravel paths and light off-road exploration, with 700C wheels and 40C tyres offering grip and stability across mixed surfaces

Riders who value durability, with a robust Hi-Ten steel frame and matching rigid fork for dependable everyday use

Simple, practical gearing, with a 7-speed LTWOO drivetrain and 50/34T chainset for everyday routes and moderate hills

Comfortable, controlled handling, with 440mm-wide handlebars and a 12-degree flare for a broader hand position

Straightforward maintenance, with quick-release hubs for convenient wheel removal

Reliable everyday braking, with cantilever brakes for controlled stopping

Weekend adventures and recreational rides, with a versatile setup suited to exploring local routes and enjoying the open road

Budget-conscious cyclists, combining practical features, classic styling and dependable construction in an accessible gravel bike
